findings.suggested_investigation: Check how the test runner in the build tooling parses test.toml cxxflags (look for environment expansion of '$HOME' or os.path.expandvars). If there is no expansion, the flag is a literal path and the test fails on other hosts. Compare with the portrait_slots_src and force_power_hotbar_src test.toml tables (the header comment says they mirror this one) to see whether they use the same $HOME path or a repo-relative one. Verify by running the common_contract_test build from a clean checkout on a machine without that workspace.
findings.why_it_matters: The [common_contract_test] table hard-codes a machine-specific $HOME path under one developer's workspace layout. If the test runner does not shell-expand $HOME in cxxflags, the include path is literal and the Common contract test cannot compile on any other machine. The sibling -I../../research/... path is also tied to a repo layout outside this mod. Either way the Common contract test is not portable.
